_note: Cassiopeia A (3C 461), supernova remnant, at 1420 MHz. Flux density from the polynomial of Perley & Butler 2017, ApJS 230, 7 (arXiv:1609.05940): 1749 Jy at epoch 2016, reduced by the secular decline of 0.67 %/yr (arXiv:1704.00002) to 1636 Jy for epoch 2026. Model: limb-brightened disc of 5.0' diameter approximating the bright radio shell (radius ~2.5'). Fine structure (knots, the fainter plateau out to ~8') is not modelled.
